name: rules-rtdb-r51-deploy-anchor-index-and-length-probes
description: RTDB rules deploy verdicts for corpus scenario "r51-deploy-anchor-index-and-length-probes" (rtdb#71). Captured by dry-run deploys to the rules endpoint, which validate without deploying. mid-pattern $, dotted or empty .indexOn entries, and long || chains are accepted or refused by pyric without a production verdict to compare.

SP-1: $ before an alternation (/a$|b/).error: Illegal regular expression, unescaped ^, ^ can only appear at the end of regular expressions

SP-1: $ inside a group (/(a$)/).error: Illegal regular expression, unescaped ^, ^ can only appear at the end of regular expressions

CS lead: .indexOn naming a dotted child.error: Invalid key: x.y. Index must be either .value or declared on a valid path
